Trace 19.32 km (recomputed 19.32006) vs booked optimal 14.6 km: excess 4.72 km, 32.33 %, established but not material; trace policy-clean under POL-RD-07. POL-RD-08 adds that the driver's assertion cites no evidence id. POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged because both advisories are present, cover the window and are fully populated. POL-RD-02 gives 26.93 - 21.43 = 5.50, exactly the refund already issued, so the driver recovers nothing and NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 leaves the rider refunded. Both blind readers reached the same ruling, money, referrals and difficulty; their only differences are two extra relevant clauses in governing_clauses and a minor imprecision about advisory-02 distances, neither of which warrants a change.
